title: Topic 7
japanese_text: 私の友人は、高校時代をすべて勉強に<u>ささげ</u>、苦手科目を<u>克服する</u>ために血の<u>にじむ</u>ような努力をし、見事東京大学に合格した。
english_translation: A friend of mine devoted all his high school years to studying, worked until he bled to overcome his weak subjects, and was successfully admitted to the University of Tokyo.
